assumptions: Straight, prismatic, rectangular cantilever with a clamped root and no axial load.
Signed transverse tip force and uniform distributed load act in one bending plane.
Linear elasticity and small rotations. Deflection above 5% of span flags that approximation.
Limit checks use continuous closed-form extrema of this fixture; mesh values and their convergence are reported separately.
Computed surface bending stress requires a separate material allowable for a strength assessment.
prediction.setup: Predict free-end transverse stiffness for the integrated rectangular silicon cantilever on die W2 30 D, 600 µm member. Use nominal width 50 µm, estimated finished thickness 1.45 µm and effective modulus 169.8 GPa from the precursor reference design. Assume the same bending direction, ideal fixed root and a linear small-deflection response. 1 nN is a numerical probe. Compare to the held-out EFB stiffness and absolute uncertainty in NIST SP 260-227, Table 1. No specimen-specific dimensions, material correction or model uncertainty are available.

measurements.condition_record: Integrated silicon cantilever, W2 30 D, nominal 600 µm length. Appendix C describes the stylus and electrostatic force balance measuring transverse static stiffness, locating the beam edge and correcting the off-end contact position to give stiffness at the free end. Nominal dimensions identify the model. The source supplies no independent measurement of this individual beam’s thickness for this comparison.
measurements.source: Gates et al., NIST SP 260-227 (2022), Table 1, printed page 9, W2 30 D, 600 µm row, electrostatic force balance columns. https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.SP.260-227
measurements.trial_id: NIST SP 260-227 / Table 1 / W2 30 D / 600 µm / EFB
measurements.uncertainty_basis: The EFB column marks uncertainty as SD in N/m. Appendix C combines measurement statistics and off-end placement contributions in quadrature. This is the source’s reported standard uncertainty. No expanded coverage probability or separate model uncertainty is assigned here.
